title: Not so many enchantments
description: This data pack adds new custom vanilla-like enchantments to minecraft
body:
# Information
This datapack so far adds **a few** enchantments that feel like the **vanilla ones**.
# Enchantment information

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Explosive - Whenever the player is mining a block (at the start) has a 5% chance to explode. The change increases by 2.5% each level. (max 4)
- Sifter - When the player breaks stone it has a chance to drop raw iron, raw gold, raw copper. Incompatible with silk touch, but works with fortune 3. The chance to drop the raw iron, gold and copper has a 10% change at level 1 and 20% chance at level 2.
- Auto Smelt - The chance to drop a instantly smelted ore is 15% on level 1, goes up to level 3.
- Short pickaxe - Curse. Removes 0.5 interaction block range.
- Anti Gravity - Removes 0.03 gravity on the player. Only on elytras.
- Sculk Walker goes up to level 3, makes you walk as fast on sculk like using the soul variant.

</details>
